span.normalized: On October 6, 2014, LMC Bermuda Ltd., Franco-Nevada and FNBC entered into the Candelaria stream agreement, as amended, to sell to FNBC a gold and silver stream from Candelaria Copper Mining Complex for an upfront deposit of $648.0 million. In addition to the upfront deposit, FNBC will make ongoing payments upon delivery under the stream.
span.raw: On October 6, 2014, LMC Bermuda Ltd., Franco-Nevada and FNBC entered into the Candelaria stream agreement, as amended, to sell to FNBC a gold and silver stream from Candelaria Copper Mining Complex  for an upfront deposit of $648.0 million. In addition to the upfront deposit, FNBC will make ongoing payments upon delivery under the stream.
